verdict.line: You lose if you let Urgot poke you down before 6 and brawl into his Purge; you win if you shove him off minions and force dry trades at point-blank range.

brief.thesis: Urgot has 800 range on Q (Corrosive Charge) and 490 range on W (Purge) while Riven has no ranged tool until R, so he dictates every trade from outside your Q (Broken Wings, range 275) and E (Valor, range 250) threat range. The matchup overall sits at 48.4% over 618 games with lane and solo-kill advantage both on Urgot, which matches a ranged poke laner versus an all-in melee diver with no gap closer besides dash range.

theirWindow.what: He can walk up, land Q (Corrosive Charge) for the slow, and threaten to Disdain you into a bad position if you overextend. Hold position until it's down.

yourWindow.when: After he uses Disdain (E) and it's on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your only safe window to close the gap with Q (Broken Wings) and E (Valor) without eating a trample-and-throw. Commit your all-in here, not before.

start.why: 48.4% win rate over 589 games and the standard 78.5% pick; the extra damage and sustain help you survive poke and threaten short trades when he overextends for CS.

boots.why: 47.8% win rate over 387 games; the ability haste shortens your E (Valor) and Q (Broken Wings) cooldowns so you can re-engage faster after he kites you with Disdain.

core.why: 75.6% win rate over 41 games on this path; the shield from consecutive-hit damage helps you survive the trade window after you close distance.
Pairs with Eclipse at 75.6% win rate; sustain from the passive keeps you alive through his ranged poke phase.
Damage reduction over time lets you survive the burst from Purge and Corrosive Charge stacking in a single engage.

he's building tanky and you need the armor shred to keep killing him in extended fights

runes.keystoneWhy: You need the stacking adaptive force and healing to outlast a ranged poke laner in extended trades; every point of healing matters when his Q and auto-attacks chip you down before you can close the gap.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 91.2% of games at this matchup's 47.9% win rate; Ignite punishes the short window when you land a dive before Disdain comes back up, since you won't get many clean kill windows.

playing.title: Track his Disdain cooldown
playing.detail: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s. Only commit your E (Valor) engage when you've seen it used and know it's down; otherwise he trsamples you off and throws you away from minions.

playing.title: Don't walk into Corrosive Charge range
playing.detail: Q has 800 range and slows on explosion. Stay behind minions or out of line until you're ready to all-in, since the slow sets up every follow-up trade he wants.

playing.title: Save Valor for closing distance, not blocking
playing.detail: E (Valor) only blocks incoming damage while active for a short dash; use it to close the gap into his Purge range rather than holding it defensively, since you can't out-trade him from range anyway.

playing.title: All-in only after Disdain is spent
playing.detail: Your full combo (Q into W stun into R) only works if he can't Disdain you away mid-fight. Bait the dash with a minion or wait for him to use it on a wave.

playing.title: Respect Purge once he's in range
playing.detail: Purge unloads on you at 490 range and triggers Echoing Flames stacks from his passive. If you're forced to fight at that range, you're losing the trade — close inside 275 (your Q range) immediately.

playing.title: Use R to threaten resets, not just damage
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile grants attack damage, range, and a single Wind Slash. Hold it to punish him for overextending on a Q poke rather than burning it on cooldown.

playing.title: Play for midgame item spikes
playing.detail: The lane favors him through level 8, but Eclipse and Endless Hunger online around 9-13 let you force fights he can't poke his way out of. Don't tilt-dive early; wait for your power spike.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing windows are my own read of the kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Urgot’s passive ability early game. Afterwards, it is important to avoid Urgot’s (E) ability while keeping your Conqueror’s stacks up when fighting.
